rationale: Classified my round-1 ask (G6) at the round-2 tip (0783a507) and swept both fix commits (0d21cb26 code, 0783a507 docs) for any OTHER naming-scheme outlier the fixer's other changes might have introduced. G6 is ADDRESSED, fully: internal/complete/materialize.go:548 now prints `WARN residual-artifact-dirt: ...` (kebab-case, no namespace prefix), matching the house grammar (bead-scope, cmd-docs, missing-source-globs, adr-divergence-proposed) exactly as recommended. The fixer went beyond the minimal ask: (1) the misleading `else if knownResidualArtifactDirt` fallback branch I hadn't flagged but R7 (F6) had is DROPPED entirely — sExitContract's fresh classification is now sole authority for the survived-materialization claim, closing the R7-identified logic bug that shared this code path; (2) the warned paths are now termsafe-escaped via termsafeEscapeEach(artifactDirt), consistent with G3's chokepoint-escaping hardening applied to every other dirt render in the same file (sExitGenuineDirtRefusal's userDirt got the same treatment); (3) the doc comment at materialize.go:536-538 explicitly documents the naming rule going forward, citing bead-scope/missing-source-globs as the pattern to follow and attributing the fix to R5/R11 by name — this converts a one-off fix into a documented convention future beads can't silently violate again; (4) the test at complete_test.go:2853 positively asserts the new kebab-case string AND (2856) negatively asserts the old dotted/snake_case string never resurfaces — a regression guard I did not explicitly ask for but is exactly the right shape to make this fix durable. Swept the full round-2 fix diff (38 non-test .go files, ~1478/-157 lines) for other new naming-scheme outliers: every new/changed string follows an established convention already verified coherent in round 1 — lowercase `warning: <freetext>` (RenderBDError wrapping added throughout is a rendering-safety change, not a new prefix or shape), the `guard.NewFailure(msg, "mindspec <verb> <id>   (<parenthetical>)")` three-space-before-paren recovery shape (new sites: the write-ahead-marker-attestation refusal in materialize.go, its recovery reads `mindspec complete %s   (re-run once bd metadata writes are healthy)` — same shape as its six bead-6 siblings per the fixer's own note), and inline backtick-quoted `run \`mindspec X\`` recovery clauses embedded in Errorf strings (next/select.go, next/beads.go rewordings) matching the pre-existing pattern in state.go. The new truthful approve-tail success message in cmd/mindspec/spec.go (G5, `Approval artifacts committed...` + numbered `Next steps:` list) correctly mirrors its more relevant sibling — plan_cmd.go's numbered `Next steps:` list for the same single-item-continuation shape — rather than next.go's bulleted `Next steps:` list, which is used for a structurally different multiple-alternatives scenario; that numbered-vs-bulleted split predates this branch and is not a new outlier. No new WARN-prefixed line, no new attention-prefix family, and no new recovery-hint delivery mechanism appears anywhere in the fix commits. G6 is closed cleanly with no collateral inconsistency introduced.
